title: Textile — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Textile Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

modelNumber.title: Model Number
modelNumber.description: Manufacturer's model number or variant identifier
modelNumber.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(5) — type, batch, serial number or other identifying element

batchLotNumber.title: Batch Number
batchLotNumber.description: Production batch identifier for traceability and recalls
batchLotNumber.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(5) — type, batch, serial number or other identifying element

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Item-level unique serial number (optional, for item-level tracking)

euResponsiblePerson.title: EU Responsible Person
euResponsiblePerson.description: Designated EU responsible person per EU product safety regulation
euResponsiblePerson.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 16 — an EU-established responsible economic operator must EXIST

productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Commercial product name or trade designation

productCategory.title: Product Category
productCategory.description: Type of textile product: apparel, footwear, or home textile

productDescription.title: Product Description
productDescription.description: Detailed description of the textile product

fiberComposition.title: Fiber Composition
fiberComposition.description: Array of fibers with ISO 2076 codes and percentages, must sum to 100%
fiberComposition.x-provision: Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Arts. 9(1), 14(1), 16 — a durable, legible label physically attached to the product, in the language of the Member State

recycledContentPercentage.title: Recycled Content Percentage
recycledContentPercentage.description: Percentage of recycled content by weight in the product

careInstructions.title: Care Instructions
careInstructions.description: Care label codes per ISO 3758 (washing, bleaching, drying, ironing, professional care)

substancesOfConcern.title: Substances of Concern
substancesOfConcern.description: Array of hazardous substances with CAS number and concentration, threshold >0.1%
substancesOfConcern.x-provision: REACH (EC) 1907/2006 Art. 33(1) — to B2B recipients on request, above 0.1% w/w, minimum content the substance name

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: List of relevant certifications such as OEKO-TEX, GOTS, EU Ecolabel, Bluesign, etc.

countryOfManufacture.title: Country of Manufacture
countryOfManufacture.description: Country where the product was manufactured, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon Footprint
carbonFootprint.description: Total carbon footprint per product in kg CO2 equivalent

environmentalFootprintScore.title: Environmental Footprint Score (PEF)
environmentalFootprintScore.description: Environmental footprint score in milli-points per EU PEF methodology

recyclabilityScore.title: Recyclability Score
recyclabilityScore.description: Recyclability score from 0-10 per JRC methodology. Auto-zero if >15% elastane.

recyclabilityLabel.title: Recyclability Label
recyclabilityLabel.description: Qualitative recyclability label: recyclable or non-recyclable

monoMaterialPercentage.title: Mono-Material Percentage
monoMaterialPercentage.description: Percentage of the product that is a single material type, key factor in recyclability

expectedLifespan.title: Expected Lifespan
expectedLifespan.description: Expected product lifespan with value and unit (years or wash_cycles)

durabilityAbrasionResistance.title: Abrasion Resistance
durabilityAbrasionResistance.description: Abrasion resistance in Martindale cycles per ISO 12947

durabilityColorFastnessWashing.title: Color Fastness to Washing
durabilityColorFastnessWashing.description: Color fastness to washing grade per ISO 105-C06

durabilityColorFastnessLight.title: Color Fastness to Light
durabilityColorFastnessLight.description: Color fastness to light grade per ISO 105-B02

durabilityDimensionalStability.title: Dimensional Stability (Shrinkage)
durabilityDimensionalStability.description: Dimensional change after washing as percentage shrinkage per ISO 5077

durabilityTearStrength.title: Tear Strength
durabilityTearStrength.description: Tear strength in Newtons per ISO 13937

repairInstructions.title: Repair Instructions
repairInstructions.description: URL to repair instructions for the textile product

sparePartsAvailability.title: Spare Parts Availability
sparePartsAvailability.description: Information about availability of spare parts (buttons, zippers, patches, etc.)

disassemblyInstructions.title: Disassembly Instructions
disassemblyInstructions.description: URL to disassembly instructions for recycling preparation

recyclingInstructions.title: Recycling Instructions
recyclingInstructions.description: Instructions for proper recycling of the textile product

collectionPointsUrl.title: Collection Points URL
collectionPointsUrl.description: URL to find nearby textile collection/drop-off points

takeBackProgram.title: Take-Back Program
takeBackProgram.description: Information about manufacturer's take-back program: availability and URL

microplasticsRelease.title: Microplastics Release
microplasticsRelease.description: Whether the product releases microplastics and synthetic fiber percentage

microplasticsSheddingRate.title: Microplastics Shedding Rate
microplasticsSheddingRate.description: Microplastics shedding rate in mg/kg per wash cycle

supplyChainTraceability.title: Supply Chain Traceability
supplyChainTraceability.description: Array of supply chain stages with country and facility name

weavingCountry.title: Weaving Country
weavingCountry.description: Country where weaving/knitting took place, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required by French AGEC.

dyeingCountry.title: Dyeing Country
dyeingCountry.description: Country where dyeing/printing took place, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required by French AGEC.

assemblyCountry.title: Assembly Country
assemblyCountry.description: Country where final assembly (sewing) took place, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required by French AGEC.

dyeingMethod.title: Dyeing Method
dyeingMethod.description: Method used for dyeing the textile (e.g. piece dyeing, yarn dyeing, solution dyeing)

finishingProcesses.title: Finishing Processes
finishingProcesses.description: Array of finishing processes applied to the textile (e.g. water-repellent, anti-wrinkle, softening)

waterConsumptionLiters.title: Water Consumption
waterConsumptionLiters.description: Total water consumed per unit during production in liters

energyConsumptionKwh.title: Energy Consumption
energyConsumptionKwh.description: Total energy consumed per unit during production in kWh

transportDistanceKm.title: Transport Distance
transportDistanceKm.description: Total transport distance from production to market in kilometers

transportMode.title: Transport Mode
transportMode.description: Primary mode of transport used for shipping the product

laborConditionsCertification.title: Labor Conditions Certification
laborConditionsCertification.description: Labor/social compliance certification such as SA8000

animalWelfareStatus.title: Animal Welfare Status
animalWelfareStatus.description: Animal welfare certifications such as RDS (Responsible Down Standard), RWS (Responsible Wool Standard)

packagingRecycledContentPct.title: Packaging Recycled Content
packagingRecycledContentPct.description: Percentage of recycled content in the product packaging

packagingRecyclability.title: Packaging Recyclability
packagingRecyclability.description: Whether the product packaging is recyclable

ecoScoreValue.title: Eco-Score Value
ecoScoreValue.description: French eco-score value in milli-points (mPt). Required if selling in France since Oct 2025.

ecoScoreGrade.title: Eco-Score Grade
ecoScoreGrade.description: French eco-score letter grade A-E. Required if selling in France since Oct 2025.

pefClimateChange.title: PEF Climate Change Impact
pefClimateChange.description: Product Environmental Footprint climate change impact in kg CO2 equivalent

pefWaterUse.title: PEF Water Use
pefWaterUse.description: Product Environmental Footprint water use impact in cubic meter equivalents

pefResourceDepletion.title: PEF Resource Depletion
pefResourceDepletion.description: Product Environmental Footprint resource depletion (minerals and metals) impact

durabilityBonusMalus.title: Durability Bonus/Malus
durabilityBonusMalus.description: Durability bonus or malus adjustment applied in eco-score calculation

microfiberReleaseCoefficient.title: Microfiber Release Coefficient
microfiberReleaseCoefficient.description: Microfiber release coefficient used in French eco-score calculation
